intro: Gaerolas Talvethren is a night elf sentinel standing watch over the ruins of Starbreeze Village in Teldrassil. Appointed as the protector of the Sleeping druids, he seeks aid in confronting the aggressive furbolgs and dark corruption unsettling the boughs.

p: Positioned amid the troubled settlement of Starbreeze Village, Gaerolas Talvethren bears the solemn mantle of protecting the Sleeping druids who slumber in communion with the Emerald Dream. His vigilance has grown fraught as unnatural corruption creeps through the forest, unsettling the balance of Teldrassil.

Gaerolas directs travelers to push back against the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs, whose minds have turned to madness and savagery. By investigating the taint spreading from their shamans and finding the roots of their distress, he hopes to preserve what sanctity remains in eastern Teldrassil.
